title: Claude Code token breakdown
description: Where Claude Code tokens and cost go: by token type (input, output, cache read, cache write), by agent and sub agent, by session, and by model. Prices are derived from Claude Code's reported cost using fixed price ratios between token types (hidden variables out_mult, cache_read_mult, cache_write_mult). Range totals sum each series' final counter value inside the time range.

panels.title: Total tokens
panels.description: All token types, including cache reads.

targets.expr: sum(last_over_time(claude_code_token_usage_tokens_total{project=~"$project", model=~"$model", query_source=~"$query_source", session_id=~"$session"}[$__range]))

panels.title: Cost (reported)
panels.description: Claude Code's own estimate at API list prices.

targets.expr: sum(last_over_time(claude_code_cost_usage_USD_total{project=~"$project", model=~"$model", query_source=~"$query_source", session_id=~"$session"}[$__range]))

panels.title: Cache hit rate
panels.description: cacheRead / (cacheRead + cacheCreation + uncached input). Higher is cheaper.

targets.expr: sum(last_over_time(claude_code_token_usage_tokens_total{type="cacheRead", project=~"$project", model=~"$model", query_source=~"$query_source", session_id=~"$session"}[$__range])) / (sum(last_over_time(claude_code_token_usage_tokens_total{type="cacheRead", project=~"$project", model=~"$model", query_source=~"$query_source", session_id=~"$session"}[$__range])) + sum(last_over_time(claude_code_token_usage_tokens_total{type="cacheCreation", project=~"$project", model=~"$model", query_source=~"$query_source", session_id=~"$session"}[$__range])) + sum(last_over_time(claude_code_token_usage_tokens_total{type="input", project=~"$project", model=~"$model", query_source=~"$query_source", session_id=~"$session"}[$__range])))

panels.title: Saved by cache reads
panels.description: What cache-read tokens would have cost at the full input price, minus what they cost. Telemetry reports only a total cost per request, not per token type. Each model's input price is derived as reported cost / ratio-weighted tokens, and the other types use fixed Anthropic price ratios (out_mult, cache_read_mult, cache_write_mult in the dashboard variables), so the per-type costs add up to the reported cost.

targets.expr: sum(last_over_time(claude_code_token_usage_tokens_total{type="cacheRead", project=~"$project", model=~"$model", query_source=~"$query_source", session_id=~"$session"}[$__range]) * (1 - $cache_read_mult) * on (model) group_left () (sum by (model) (last_over_time(claude_code_cost_usage_USD_total[$__range])) / sum by (model) ((last_over_time(claude_code_token_usage_tokens_total{type="input"}[$__range])) or (last_over_time(claude_code_token_usage_tokens_total{type="output"}[$__range]) * $out_mult) or (last_over_time(claude_code_token_usage_tokens_total{type="cacheRead"}[$__range]) * $cache_read_mult) or (last_over_time(claude_code_token_usage_tokens_total{type="cacheCreation"}[$__range]) * $cache_write_mult))))

panels.title: USD per 1M tokens
panels.description: Blended price across all token types. Cache reads dominate the token count, so this is far below the input price.

targets.expr: sum(last_over_time(claude_code_cost_usage_USD_total{project=~"$project", model=~"$model", query_source=~"$query_source", session_id=~"$session"}[$__range])) / (sum(last_over_time(claude_code_token_usage_tokens_total{project=~"$project", model=~"$model", query_source=~"$query_source", session_id=~"$session"}[$__range])) / 1e6)

panels.title: Models: tokens and cost
panels.description: Telemetry reports only a total cost per request, not per token type. Each model's input price is derived as reported cost / ratio-weighted tokens, and the other types use fixed Anthropic price ratios (out_mult, cache_read_mult, cache_write_mult in the dashboard variables), so the per-type costs add up to the reported cost.
